title: Binance CEO says 90 percent of stolen assets have been ‘replenished’

claims.claim: Hackers stole $6.3 billion from Binance customers in a crypto heist.

evidence.quote: After hackers stole a shocking $6.3 billion from Binance customers in a record-breaking crypto heist

claims.claim: Binance CEO stated that 90 percent of the stolen funds have been replaced.

evidence.quote: the company’s CEO says that 90 percent of the funds have been replaced
After hackers stole a shocking $6.3 billion from Binance customers in a record-breaking crypto heist, the company’s CEO says that 90 percent of the funds have been replaced

claims.claim: The company plans to cover the remaining 10 percent of the stolen funds, which consist of less liquid tokens.

evidence.quote: the company plans to cover the remaining 10 percent as well. Binance is covering the stolen funds directly, and the remaining 10 percent consists of “less liquid” tokens

the company plans to cover the remaining 10 percent as well. Binance is covering the stolen funds directly, and the remaining 10 percent consists of “less liquid” tokens, which the company says may take longer to acquire.

claims.claim: Binance withdrawals remain temporarily paused following the incident.

evidence.quote: while withdrawals remain paused
The company also said in a post on X that, while withdrawals remain paused, they’re on track to be enabled on Sunday.

claims.claim: Binance is on track to enable withdrawals again on Sunday, 2026-11-01.

evidence.quote: We remain on track to reopen withdrawals within our previously stated timeframe (on Sunday, 2026-11-01)
We remain on track to reopen withdrawals within our previously stated timeframe (on Sunday, 2026-11-01) and will provide a further update as soon as details are confirmed.
